# Claims Assessment Memo

## Summary

Bramble Hill Dental (policy CC-1555) reported the theft of a projector and a sound bar from an unattended bag at its van, which was parked overnight. The police report records that the items were left in a shared area and were not in a locked container. Exclusion 7.1 (unattended property) applies, so the claim is not covered.

## Facts

- The insured is Bramble Hill Dental, under policy CC-1555. [notice of loss]
- The loss was reported on 6 September 2026. [notice of loss]
- The loss is the theft of a projector and a sound bar from an unattended bag at the insured's van, parked overnight. [notice of loss]
- The theft was reported to police on 8 September 2026 under reference CR/2026/4195, by Bramble Hill Dental. [police report]
- The police report states that the items were left in a shared area and were not in a locked container. [police report]
- The projector was supplied by Beacon Office Supply at 2,955 dollars. [invoice 1]
- The sound bar was supplied by Crane & Sons Electronics at 2,165 dollars. [invoice 2]
- The date of the theft is not stated in the file. [notice of loss] [police report]
- The file contains the policy extract only. It contains no policy schedule. [policy]

## Coverage analysis

**Insuring clauses**

- **Clause 4.2 (Contents).** This clause covers theft of business contents at the scheduled premises, and at other premises while in the insured's custody. [policy, cl. 4.2] The loss is a theft, so it falls within the type of peril this clause covers. The cover is subject to the exclusions below.
- **Clause 4.5 (Transit).** This clause covers accidental loss of portable equipment while being carried by an employee between premises. [policy, cl. 4.5] The file describes items in an unattended bag at a parked van, not equipment being carried by an employee. [notice of loss] [police report] Clause 4.5 does not apply.
- **Clauses 4.7 and 4.9 (Escape of water; Electrical surge).** The loss is a theft. No water damage or electrical surge is reported. [notice of loss] [police report] These clauses do not apply.

**Exclusions**

- **Clause 7.1 (Unattended property).** This clause excludes theft of portable equipment left unattended in a shared or public space, unless it was in a locked container or locked room at the time. [policy, cl. 7.1] The items were taken from an unattended bag. [notice of loss] [police report] The police report records that they were left in a shared area and were not in a locked container. [police report] Nothing in the file indicates a locked room. The exclusion applies.
- **Clause 7.5 (Unproven loss).** This clause excludes a theft loss not reported to police within seven days. [policy, cl. 7.5] The police report is dated 8 September 2026. [police report] The file does not give the date of the theft, so whether the report fell within seven days cannot be determined from the file. [notice of loss] [police report] The decision rests on clause 7.1 and does not depend on clause 7.5.
- **Clause 7.3 (Wear and tear).** This clause excludes gradual deterioration. [policy, cl. 7.3] The loss is a reported theft, and no deterioration is described. [notice of loss] [police report] The exclusion does not apply.

## Decision

**Not covered.** The loss is a theft of portable equipment left unattended in a shared area and not in a locked container. It is excluded under clause 7.1. [policy, cl. 7.1] [police report]

## Reserve

Under clause 9.1, the reserve is the sum of the invoices in the file, less any excess shown in the policy schedule. [policy, cl. 9.1]

| Item | Amount (dollars) |
|---|---|
| Projector [invoice 1] | 2,955 |
| Sound bar [invoice 2] | 2,165 |
| Sum of invoices | 5,120 |
| Excess | none shown |
| **Reserve** | **5,120** |

No schedule is in the file, so no excess is shown and none applies. [policy, cl. 9.1] The reserve under clause 9.1 is therefore 5,120 dollars. [invoice 1] [invoice 2] This figure is calculated on the clause 9.1 basis and should be read together with the decision above that the claim is not covered.
